nvitk.gui.viz.layers
====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.layers

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Napari-native visualization (hotspots, 4D flow vectors) without PyVista.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: HOTSPOTS_LAYER
   :value: 'SUV hotspots'


.. py:data:: FLOW_VECTORS_LAYER
   :value: 'Flow velocity'


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_FLOW_EDGE_WIDTH
   :value: 0.3


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_HOTSPOT_POINT_SIZE
   :value: 6.0


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_HOTSPOT_COLORMAP
   :value: 'viridis'


.. py:class:: FlowVectorCache

   Precomputed subsampled flow glyphs for all cardiac phases.


   .. py:attribute:: positions
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: velocities
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: magnitudes
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: n_time
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: max_arrow_voxels
      :type:  float


   .. py:attribute:: speed_percentile
      :type:  float


.. py:function:: hotspot_points_from_volumes(suv: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, *, label_ids=None, hotspot='top_percent', top_percent=0.1, top_k=None, threshold=None, max_points=20000) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray, dict[str, numpy.ndarray]]

   Return Napari point coordinates (N,3), SUV values, and feature columns.

   Subsamples to *max_points* by highest SUV when needed.


.. py:class:: HotspotPointsState

   Tracks SUV hotspot layer and Napari 0.7 style-sync callbacks.


   .. py:attribute:: layer
      :type:  Any


   .. py:attribute:: disconnect_style_sync
      :value: None



.. py:function:: stop_hotspot_points_sync(viewer: Any) -> None

   Disconnect style-sync hooks from a prior SUV hotspot layer.


.. py:function:: _point_feature_columns(layer: Any) -> set[str]

   Column names on a Napari Points ``features`` table (dict or DataFrame).


.. py:function:: install_points_style_sync(layer: Any, *, sync_face_color: bool = False) -> Callable[[], None]

   Napari 0.5+: broadcast layer-panel style controls to all points.

   Without this, the GUI sliders only affect the next added or selected points.


.. py:function:: init_points_layer_style(layer: Any, *, size: float, symbol: str, face_color: Any) -> None

   Set scalar style on all points and align Napari ``current_*`` controls.


.. py:function:: add_hotspot_points_layer(viewer: Any, coords: numpy.ndarray, features: dict[str, numpy.ndarray], *, reference_layer: Any, name=HOTSPOTS_LAYER, point_size=DEFAULT_HOTSPOT_POINT_SIZE, colormap=DEFAULT_HOTSPOT_COLORMAP) -> Any

   Add (replacing any prior) a Points layer for PET hotspot *coords*, colored by SUV via
   *colormap* (or plain red if there are no points), and install style-sync callbacks.


.. py:function:: _subsample_mask_indices(mask: numpy.ndarray, max_points: int, label_ids: list[int] | None) -> numpy.ndarray

   Voxel indices inside the ROI defined by *mask*/*label_ids*, evenly subsampled down to at most
   *max_points*.


.. py:function:: _time_axis_index_from_layer(layer: Any) -> int

   Array axis index for cardiac phase (``T`` / ``C``) on a 4D phase layer.


.. py:function:: _move_time_axis_last(*arrays: numpy.ndarray, time_axis: int) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, Ellipsis]

   Ensure the cardiac-phase axis is last (required by velocity_mm_s_from_phases).


.. py:function:: _displacement_from_velocity(velocities_mm_s: numpy.ndarray, *, max_arrow_voxels: float, speed_percentile=95.0) -> numpy.ndarray

   Unit direction × capped length; color still uses true speed in features.


.. py:function:: flow_vector_frame(cache: FlowVectorCache, time_index: int) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, dict[str, numpy.ndarray]]

   Build Napari vectors data (N, 2, 3) and features for one cardiac phase.


.. py:function:: flow_vectors_all_times(ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, *, phase_layer=None, label_ids=None, max_points=4000, max_arrow_voxels=5.0, speed_percentile=95.0) -> FlowVectorCache

   Precompute subsampled velocity glyphs for every cardiac phase.


.. py:function:: flow_vectors_at_time(ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, time_index: int, *, phase_layer=None, label_ids=None, max_points=4000, max_arrow_voxels=5.0, speed_percentile=95.0) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]

   Return (positions Nx3, displacement Nx3, speed N) for one cardiac phase.


.. py:function:: add_flow_vectors_layer(viewer: Any, positions: numpy.ndarray, vectors: numpy.ndarray, *, reference_layer: Any, name=FLOW_VECTORS_LAYER, features=None, speed_limits=None, colormap='turbo') -> Any

   Add (replacing any prior) a Vectors layer for the given arrow *positions*/*vectors*, colored by
   speed via *colormap* if a ``"speed"`` feature is supplied.


.. py:function:: _time_index_from_viewer(viewer: Any, phase_layer: Any, n_time: int) -> int

   Read cardiac phase from the 4D phase layer dims (not the vectors layer).


.. py:function:: _phase_dim_steps(viewer: Any, phase_layer: Any) -> list[int]

   Current integer slice indices for every axis of *phase_layer*.


.. py:function:: _install_phase_dims(viewer: Any, phase_layer: Any) -> None

   One-time 4D dims setup after adding vectors: ranges/labels, keep camera + scrubber.


.. py:function:: _repair_time_dim_range(viewer: Any, phase_layer: Any) -> None

   Fix cardiac-phase slider extent if vector layer updates polluted dims.range.


.. py:function:: _topmost_phase_layer(viewer: Any) -> Any | None

   Topmost 4D+ Image/Labels layer (cardiac-phase volume), if any.


.. py:function:: repair_time_dim_for_viewer(viewer: Any) -> None

   Force the cardiac-phase slider to the true phase count.

   Adding 3D overlays/volumes next to a 4D ``XYZT`` layer makes Napari right-align
   their spatial axes onto the 4D time world-axis, inflating the slider to thousands
   of steps. Re-applying the phase layer's own time extent restores the real count.


.. py:function:: _global_speed_limits(cache: FlowVectorCache) -> tuple[float, float]

   2nd/98th percentile speed magnitude across all cached cardiac phases, for fixed-range coloring.


.. py:class:: FlowVectorPlayback

   Dims-synced flow vector layer (updates with Napari time slider / play bar).


   .. py:attribute:: cache
      :type:  FlowVectorCache


   .. py:attribute:: phase_layer
      :type:  Any


   .. py:attribute:: layer
      :type:  Any


   .. py:attribute:: dims_callback
      :type:  Callable[[Any], None]


.. py:function:: stop_flow_vector_playback(viewer: Any) -> None

   Disconnect dims hooks from a prior flow-vector overlay.


.. py:function:: _update_flow_vector_layer(layer: Any, cache: FlowVectorCache, time_index: int, *, viewer=None, phase_layer=None) -> None

   Recompute and push the flow-vector geometry/features for *time_index* onto *layer*, repairing
   the viewer's time-dim range against *phase_layer* if both are given.


.. py:function:: add_animated_flow_vectors_layer(viewer: Any, cache: FlowVectorCache, *, phase_layer: Any, spatial_reference_layer=None, name=FLOW_VECTORS_LAYER, initial_time=0, sync_dims=True, colormap='turbo') -> FlowVectorPlayback

   Add flow vectors; sync glyph data to the Napari dims slider / play bar.


.. py:function:: voxel_spacing_from_layer(layer: Any) -> tuple[float, float, float]

   *layer*'s (x, y, z) voxel spacing, or ``(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)`` if unavailable.
